commitResults.messageTitle: docs: polish Target user profile, Value proposition, and User stories sections
commitResults.messageBody:
- Enhanced target user profile with more specific details about event scale and workflow
- Improved value proposition clarity with focus on offline capability and keyboard-first design
- Expanded user stories with better role distinction and more comprehensive scenarios
- Added new user stories for undo/redo, CSV import/export, custom tags, and accessibility

commitResults.messageTitle: Update delete feature to use applicant terminology

commitResults.messageBody:
- Add Team class as optional field for Person/Applicant
- Update AddCommand to support team parameter (tm/)
- Update EditCommand to support team modification
- Create FilterCommand to filter by team name or no-team status
- Update Messages.format() to display team information
- Update storage layer (JsonAdaptedPerson) for team persistence
- Update all tests and builders to support team field

New commands:
- add ... tm/TEAM_NAME - Add applicant with team
- edit INDEX tm/TEAM_NAME - Assign/change team
- edit INDEX tm/ - Remove team from applicant
- filter TEAM_NAME - Filter applicants by team
- filter no-team - Show applicants without team
FilterCommand will be implemented by teammate

- Resolved conflicts by combining team feature with GitHub and RsvpStatus features
- Person class now supports all three optional fields: team, github, rsvpStatus
- Updated all parsers, storage, and test utilities to handle combined features
- Removed bin/ directory from git tracking
